summary: Exited at +81.75pts after riding a very whipsaw short: the trade round-tripped from +139 peak fully into a -22.75 loss and back multiple times before I closed near the 19-frame drill limit. The exit was driven by frame-count end-of-episode plus a rising giveback (22% off the last 140.8pt leg) after already having watched two full round-trips, not by a single against-fire (HA/PROPP were actually realigned with the position at exit). Next time I'd want a clearer during-trade signal (e.g., a dedicated reversal/R-trigger flag) to time exits on strong legs rather than defaulting to hold-through-giveback and only cutting when the clock runs out — the repeated full reversals suggest a giveback-based partial-lock rule could have captured more of the peak (e.g., near +139 or +117) instead of round-tripping down to +81.75.
